title: Replaced Stripe key still inside its documented grace period
summary: A secret-key-shaped value that a notes file says was rotated out, written beside its replacement, with no indication of when the rotation happened. Shape only; no value is recorded in this record.
rationale: The provider documents that a rotated key keeps working for up to 7 days when rotated in the Dashboard. A reader of the text cannot tell whether the note was written minutes or years ago. The ambiguity is whether a predecessor value should be treated as live; the facts do not choose, and neither does any scanner.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, ADR 0019 item 6 (#112)): expect it to be flagged. Provider-documented: both keys work for up to 7 days after a Dashboard rotation. Not documented: how text that names a rotated-out key should be treated. Offline text cannot establish revocation or expiry. This is a policy, not a validity claim. Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history.

sources.supports: When you rotate a key in the Dashboard, both the old and new keys work for up to 7 days.
sources.locator: section 'Rotate safely to avoid downtime', item 'Use the grace period'

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Maintainer-only (ADR 0020): decided by the sole maintainer, not reviewed, not independent validation; queued for retro-review (#154).
